subject: Scheduling procurement intake — stakeholder map, timeline & mutual action plan
messages:
From: Sara Lewis <sara@horizon-analytics.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Michael Chu <mchu@horizon-analytics.com>, procurement@horizon-analytics.com
Date: 2026-09-01T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood procurement intake + PO process kickoff

Hi Karthik,

We're close to finalizing a vendor list for our new analytics pipeline and Redwood is on track to be selected pending procurement intake and a short PO process. Our procurement team would like to run a brief kickoff to align on: required forms, proposed PO flow (template), billing cadence, and an implementation timeline.

Can we schedule a 45-minute intake call next week? Key constraints on our side: budget approval by 2026-09-22 and PO needs to be issued before 2026-09-26. I attached our vendor requirements doc for reference.

Attendees from our side: Sara Lewis (PM, vendor owner), Michael Chu (CFO), Procurement Ops (procurement@horizon-analytics.com).

Please let me know 2–3 time slots that work for your team and any pre-read or forms you need filled out.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Lewis
Vendor Programs Manager
Horizon Analytics

Attachments: Horizon_vendor_requirements.pdf (PDF)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lewis <sara@horizon-analytics.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-02T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood procurement intake + PO process kickoff

Hi Sara — thanks for sending this over and congrats on getting to budget sign-off. Happy to run the intake call and map a short mutual action plan (MAP) so we hit your 9/22–9/26 gates.

Proposed 45-min windows (PT):
- Tue 2026-09-08 10:00–10:45
- Wed 2026-09-09 14:00–14:45
- Thu 2026-09-10 09:00–09:45

Suggested internal attendees and owners (so you know who will speak to each area):
- Karthik Iyer — Sales lead / procurement owner (align MAP and approve PO terms)
- Lauren Bishop — Procurement intake / commercial operations (billing & PO ops)
- Markus Klein — Finance & invoicing (PO acceptance, invoicing cadence)
- Mina Haddad — Onboarding & technical enablement (implementation milestones)

Draft agenda (45 min):
1) 5m — Introductions & goals for the intake
2) 10m — Horizon vendor requirements (Sara / Procurement Ops) + clarifying Qs
3) 10m — Redwood PO flow & billing options (Lauren / Markus)
4) 10m — MAP: milestones, ownership, and dates (Karthik / Mina)
5) 5m — Pre-reads / deliverables before kickoff; next steps

Pre-reads / attachments included: Redwood_MAP_draft_20260902.xlsx (MAP template), vendor-onboarding-checklist.pdf (onboarding form we ask customers to complete). I also dropped the MAP draft into a shared Drive (link below). If you have a PO template, please attach it and we'll align on fields we need (W9, billing address, legal contact).

Ask: please confirm which of the slots above works and share the names + emails of any additional legal/compliance contacts that should join. If you prefer a different time, we can adjust.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/redwood/Maps/Redwood_MAP_draft_20260902

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Partnerships & Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_draft_20260902.xlsx (Excel), vendor-onboarding-checklist.pdf (PDF)
From: Sara Lewis <sara@horizon-analytics.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Michael Chu <mchu@horizon-analytics.com>, procurement@horizon-analytics.com
Date: 2026-09-03T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood procurement intake + PO process kickoff

Karthik — thanks, Tue 9/8 10:00 PT works for us. I've added our legal contact (Alyssa Park, alyssa.park@horizon-analytics.com) to the attendee list. Michael (CFO) will join for the first 20 minutes to sign off on budget assumptions.

I've attached our PO template (Horizon_PO_template.docx) and flagged that we require proof of SOC 2 or equivalent for vendors storing customer data. If you can attach a current SOC 2 report or a link to your compliance page before the call, that would speed things up.

Attendees (confirming):
- Sara Lewis (Vendor Programs Manager)
- Michael Chu (CFO)
- Alyssa Park (Legal)
- Procurement Ops (procurement@horizon-analytics.com)

See you 9/8.

Best,
Sara

Attachments: Horizon_PO_template.docx (DOCX)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lewis <sara@horizon-analytics.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com, alyssa.park@horizon-analytics.com
Date: 2026-09-04T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed — Intake call 2026-09-08 10:00 PT + pre-call asks

Great — call confirmed for Tue 2026-09-08 10:00–10:45 PT. I've booked the calendar invite and attached an updated MAP with proposed milestones and owners based on your dates. High-level success criteria we will aim to meet on this track:
- Contract signed by 2026-09-20
- PO issued by 2026-09-24
- Technical onboarding begun by 2026-09-28 and go-live target 2026-10-01

Pre-call asks (small):
- Please upload your completed vendor onboarding form (link in MAP) or send any vendor-specific fields we need filled (billing address, tax ID, W9).
- If you have a preferred invoice/code string for billing, share that so we can template invoices to match PO.
- I'll share our SOC 2 summary and a link to our compliance page prior to the call.

Internal owner notes:
- Lauren: lead on PO acceptance and contract intake.
- Markus: confirm invoicing cadence and sample invoice fields.
- Mina: review implementation milestones / technical dependencies on the call.

I'll attach the final MAP + checklist to the calendar invite. Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Karthik
Partnerships & Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_draft_20260902.xlsx (updated), vendor-onboarding-checklist.pdf (final)
